title: 高強度螺栓預拉力施工~Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts
focus: 以夾緊力、接觸面等級、預拉方法與安裝前驗證，確保摩擦型與預拉接頭在施工及數十年使用中保持設計夾緊力~Securing design clamping force in slip-critical and pretensioned joints through clamp force, faying-surface class, pretensioning method and pre-installation verification, during construction and decades of service
summary: 從摩擦型接頭的傳力與預拉力對疲勞的作用出發，說明螺栓等級與氫脆、接觸面處理與孔型、密貼與鎖緊順序、轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與直接張力指示墊圈、安裝前驗證與施工後稽核、長期鬆弛與紀錄交接，並以 RCSC 規範 2025 年版撤除校正扳手法、舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋 2013 年錨桿斷裂、1979 年 Kemper Arena 屋頂吊架螺栓失效與雪梨港灣大橋六百萬支鉚釘為對照。~Starting from force transfer in slip-critical joints and the role of pretension in fatigue, explain bolt grades and hydrogen embrittlement, faying surfaces and hole types, snugging and tightening sequence, turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and direct tension indicators, pre-installation verification and post-installation audits, long-term relaxation and record handover, contrasted with the withdrawal of the calibrated wrench method in the 2025 RCSC Specification, the 2013 anchor-rod fractures on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge, the 1979 Kemper Arena hanger-bolt failure and the six million rivets of Sydney Harbour Bridge.

units.anchor: 接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數~Clamp force and slip coefficient
units.title: 摩擦型接頭的傳力機制~Force transfer in slip-critical joints
units.mechanism: 高強度螺栓接頭有兩種傳力方式：承壓型接頭讓板件滑動到螺栓桿與孔壁接觸，以螺栓剪力與孔壁承壓傳力；摩擦型接頭則靠螺栓預拉力把板件夾緊，以接觸面的摩擦力傳遞剪力，在使用載重下板件不滑動。需要摩擦型接頭的情況包括反覆或反向載重、疲勞敏感構件、超大孔或槽孔，以及滑動會造成幾何改變的支撐與續接。摩擦型接頭的強度因此直接取決於夾緊力與接觸面滑動係數，而不是螺栓本身的剪力強度。~High-strength bolted joints transfer force in two ways: in a bearing joint the plies slip until the shank bears on the hole, carrying force by bolt shear and bearing; in a slip-critical joint the bolt pretension clamps the plies so friction at the faying surfaces carries the shear without slip under service loads. Slip-critical joints are needed for reversing or repeated loads, fatigue-sensitive members, oversized or slotted holes, and bracing or splices where slip would change geometry. Their capacity therefore depends directly on clamp force and the faying-surface slip coefficient, not on the shear strength of the bolt itself.
units.model: 滑動強度 R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s。7/8 in A325 螺栓 T_b = 173 kN、D_u = 1.13：Class A（μ = 0.30）每支單面 0.30×1.13×173 ≈ 58.6 kN，雙剪面約 117 kN；Class B（μ = 0.50）雙剪面約 195 kN，同樣的螺栓多出約 67% 的抗滑力。數值為教學假設。~Slip resistance R = μ·D_u·T_b·n_s. For a 7/8 in A325 bolt with T_b = 173 kN and D_u = 1.13, a Class A surface (μ = 0.30) gives 0.30×1.13×173 ≈ 58.6 kN per bolt per plane, about 117 kN with two planes; a Class B surface (μ = 0.50) gives about 195 kN with two planes, about 67% more for the same bolt. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工圖須逐一標示接頭類型（密貼、預拉或摩擦型）、接觸面等級與孔型，檢驗員以此核對現場；摩擦型接頭的接觸面在組立前檢查是否有油漆、油污、鏽皮或毛邊，並與經滑動試驗認可的塗層規格比對。~Shop drawings must label each joint as snug-tight, pretensioned or slip-critical with its faying-surface class and hole type, which inspectors check on site; before fit-up, slip-critical faying surfaces are inspected for paint, oil, loose scale or burrs and compared with the coating qualified by slip testing.
units.failure: 若摩擦型接頭的接觸面被誤塗面漆，或預拉力不足，接頭在使用載重下滑動，支撐構架因螺栓孔間隙而鬆動，反覆載重下孔壁磨損、螺栓承受未設計的反覆剪力，最終產生疲勞裂縫或連接鬆脫。~If a slip-critical faying surface is painted by mistake or pretension is short, the joint slips under service load, bracing loosens through the hole clearances, and repeated loading wears the holes and subjects bolts to unintended cyclic shear, ending in fatigue cracks or a loose connection.
units.misconception: 摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。~A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
units.practice: 結構設計者應在圖說中明確指定哪些接頭必須是摩擦型及其接觸面等級，製造廠的塗裝計畫要以遮蔽標示接觸面範圍；任何接觸面塗層變更都須提出滑動係數試驗證明並經核准。~The structural designer must state which joints are slip-critical and their faying-surface class, and the fabricator's painting plan must mask and mark faying areas; any change of faying-surface coating needs slip-coefficient test evidence and approval.

units.anchor: 受拉接頭的螺栓負擔比~Bolt load share in tension joints
units.title: 預拉力與疲勞、反覆載重~Pretension, fatigue and repeated load
units.mechanism: 受拉接頭中的預拉力讓螺栓與被夾板件形成預壓的彈簧系統：外加拉力大部分只是減少板件間的壓力，螺栓本身只多承受一小部分，因此應力變化小、疲勞壽命長；但一旦外力超過分離載重，板件張開，螺栓承受全部外力並可能出現撬力。1979 年 6 月 4 日 Kansas City 的 Kemper Arena 在約 70 mph 強風與大雨中，屋頂吊架螺栓的強度被低估、積水又增加載重，一支螺栓失效後引發連鎖破壞，約 200×215 ft 的屋頂倒塌。~Pretension turns a tension joint into a preloaded spring system of bolt and clamped plies: most of an applied tension only reduces the contact pressure between plies, and the bolt picks up only a small share, so its stress range stays small and fatigue life long; once the load exceeds the separation load, the plies open, the bolt takes the whole load and prying can appear. At Kemper Arena in Kansas City on 4 June 1979, in winds of about 70 mph and heavy rain, the strength of the roof hanger bolts had been underestimated and ponding added load; one bolt gave way, starting a cascade that dropped a roof area of about 200×215 ft.
units.model: 螺栓負擔比 C = k_b/(k_b + k_m)。k_m = 4k_b 時 C = 0.2：外力反覆 100 kN 時螺栓只承受 0.2×100 = 20 kN 的變化。初始預拉 T_i = 173 kN，分離載重 P_sep = T_i/(1 − C) = 173/0.8 ≈ 216 kN；超過後螺栓承受全部外力變化。數值為教學假設。~Bolt load share C = k_b/(k_b + k_m). With k_m = 4k_b, C = 0.2, so a 100 kN cyclic load changes bolt force by only 0.2×100 = 20 kN. With initial pretension T_i = 173 kN the separation load is P_sep = T_i/(1 − C) = 173/0.8 ≈ 216 kN; beyond it the bolt carries the full load change. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 受拉或疲勞接頭的設計要檢查最大外力是否低於分離載重並計算撬力，螺栓應力範圍與疲勞類別比較；現場則確認板件平整、厚度與設計相符，因為板件剛度不足或接觸不良會讓負擔比上升。~Design of tension or fatigue joints should confirm that the peak load stays below separation, compute prying forces and compare the bolt stress range with its fatigue category; on site, confirm that plies are flat and as thick as designed, because flexible or poorly seated plies raise the bolt's load share.
units.failure: 若吊架或受拉接頭的螺栓只鎖到密貼而未預拉，每一次風振或載重變化都由螺栓全部承受，螺紋根部很快出現疲勞裂縫；一支螺栓斷裂後，其餘螺栓分擔增加，可能在同一事件中連鎖斷裂。~If hanger or tension-joint bolts are only snug-tight and not pretensioned, the bolt takes every wind cycle or load change in full and fatigue cracks soon start at the thread root; when one bolt breaks, the others take more load and can fail in a cascade during the same event.
units.misconception: 外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。~Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit.
units.practice: 吊掛屋頂、懸吊樓板或設備吊架等受拉關鍵接頭，應以冗餘設計使單一螺栓失效不致連鎖倒塌，並指定為預拉接頭且列入定期檢查清單；設計者須在計算書中寫明分離載重與撬力檢核。~Tension-critical joints such as hung roofs, suspended floors or equipment hangers should be redundant so one bolt failure cannot cascade, specified as pretensioned and placed on the periodic inspection list; the designer must record the separation-load and prying checks in the calculations.

units.anchor: 螺栓等級與鍍鋅限制~Bolt grades and galvanizing limits
units.title: 螺栓等級、材料與氫脆~Bolt grades, materials and hydrogen embrittlement
units.mechanism: 結構用高強度螺栓依 ASTM F3125 分為 A325（最低抗拉 120 ksi，約 830 MPa）與 A490（150 ksi，約 1,040 MPa）等級，以及對應的扭剪型螺栓；螺帽與墊圈須搭配相容等級。強度越高的鋼對氫脆越敏感：酸洗、電鍍或熱浸鍍鋅帶入的氫，加上持續高拉應力，可能在鎖緊後數天內造成延遲斷裂，因此 A490 等級不得熱浸鍍鋅。2013 年舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段 288 支直徑 3 in 的錨桿中，最先受拉的 96 支在兩週內有 32 支斷裂，起初即被歸因於氫脆。~Structural high-strength bolts under ASTM F3125 include Grade A325 (minimum tensile 120 ksi, about 830 MPa) and A490 (150 ksi, about 1,040 MPa) with matching twist-off versions, and nuts and washers must be of compatible grades. Higher-strength steel is more sensitive to hydrogen embrittlement: hydrogen from pickling, electroplating or hot-dip galvanizing, combined with sustained high tension, can cause delayed fracture within days of tightening, which is why Grade A490 must not be hot-dip galvanized. In 2013, of the 288 three-inch anchor rods on the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span, 32 of the first 96 to be tensioned broke within two weeks, a failure initially attributed to hydrogen embrittlement.
units.model: 最低預拉力 T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s。7/8 in 螺栓應力面積 A_s = 0.462 in²：A325 為 0.70×120×0.462 ≈ 38.8 kips，取 39 kips（約 173 kN）；A490 為 0.70×150×0.462 ≈ 48.5 kips，取 49 kips（約 218 kN）。數值為教學假設。~Minimum pretension T_b = 0.70·F_u·A_s. For a 7/8 in bolt with stress area A_s = 0.462 in², A325 gives 0.70×120×0.462 ≈ 38.8 kips, tabulated as 39 kips (about 173 kN), and A490 gives 0.70×150×0.462 ≈ 48.5 kips, tabulated as 49 kips (about 218 kN). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 進場時核對螺栓、螺帽與墊圈的製造批號、等級標記與出廠試驗報告，確認組件來自同一批並具相容性；鍍鋅或塗覆組件須確認螺帽潤滑與適用等級，並抽樣做硬度或拉伸試驗；高強度錨桿另須檢查氫脆相關的製程與試驗紀錄。~At delivery, check lot numbers, grade markings and mill test reports of bolts, nuts and washers, confirming that assemblies are from matched lots and compatible; for galvanized or coated assemblies confirm nut lubrication and permitted grade and sample for hardness or tensile tests; for high-strength anchor rods also check process and test records related to hydrogen embrittlement.
units.failure: 把 A490 螺栓送去熱浸鍍鋅，或在高硬度螺栓上使用電鍍後未除氫，鎖緊後數天在螺紋根部或頭下圓角突然斷裂，斷口平整且無明顯塑性變形；海灣大橋錨桿最後以加裝鞍座的方式補強，2013 年 12 月 19 日正式啟用。~Hot-dip galvanizing A490 bolts, or electroplating hard bolts without hydrogen relief, leads to sudden fractures at the thread root or under-head fillet days after tightening, with flat faces and little plastic deformation; the Bay Bridge rods were ultimately bypassed by added saddle assemblies, placed in service on 19 December 2013.
units.misconception: 螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。~The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.
units.practice: 規格書要寫明螺栓、螺帽與墊圈的標準與等級、表面處理限制（例如 A490 禁止熱浸鍍鋅）與批號追溯要求；現場不同批次與等級的螺栓須分區存放並保持潤滑與乾燥，未標示的螺栓不得使用。~The specification must name standards and grades for bolts, nuts and washers, coating limits (for example no hot-dip galvanizing of A490) and lot traceability; on site, different lots and grades are stored separately, kept lubricated and dry, and unmarked bolts are never used.

units.anchor: 接觸面噴砂與孔型~Blasted faying surfaces and hole types
units.title: 接觸面處理與孔型~Faying-surface preparation and hole types
units.mechanism: 摩擦型接頭的滑動係數取決於接觸面：RCSC 規範把清潔的軋鋼皮面歸為 Class A，平均滑動係數至少 0.30，噴砂清理面歸為 Class B，設計值為 0.50，且設計不得採用大於 0.50 的值；塗裝接觸面必須依附錄的滑動試驗取得等級，鍍鋅接觸面在設計上視為 Class A。孔型也影響抗滑：超大孔與槽孔讓夾緊區域減少、對位誤差增大，須折減強度。接觸面範圍內的油漆噴濺、油污與毛邊都會顯著降低摩擦。~The slip coefficient of a slip-critical joint depends on the faying surface: the RCSC Specification treats clean mill scale as Class A with a mean slip coefficient of at least 0.30 and blast-cleaned steel as Class B with a design value of 0.50, and no design value above 0.50 may be used; coated faying surfaces must earn their class by slip testing per the appendix, and galvanized faying surfaces count as Class A for design. Hole type also matters: oversized and slotted holes reduce the clamped area and allow misalignment, so strength is reduced. Paint overspray, oil and burrs within the faying area cut friction markedly.
units.model: 某支撐續接需傳遞使用剪力 900 kN，7/8 in A325 雙剪面。Class A 每支約 117 kN，需 900/117 ≈ 7.7，取 8 支；Class B 每支約 195 kN，需 900/195 ≈ 4.6，取 5 支；若改用超大孔、強度乘 0.85，Class B 每支約 166 kN，需 5.4，取 6 支。數值為教學假設。~A brace splice must carry 900 kN of service shear with 7/8 in A325 bolts in double shear. Class A gives about 117 kN per bolt, needing 900/117 ≈ 7.7, so 8 bolts; Class B gives about 195 kN, needing 900/195 ≈ 4.6, so 5 bolts; with oversized holes and a 0.85 factor, Class B gives about 166 kN, needing 5.4, so 6 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 組立前目視檢查接觸面清潔度與遮蔽範圍，噴砂面以表面粗糙度比對片或量規確認；塗裝接觸面核對塗層型號、膜厚與其滑動試驗報告是否相符，膜厚超過試驗值的部分不得視為同等級。~Before fit-up, inspect faying surfaces visually for cleanliness and masking extent and check blasted surfaces against a roughness comparator or gauge; for coated faying surfaces, confirm that coating product and film thickness match its slip-test report, since thicker films than tested do not earn the same class.
units.failure: 塗裝工人為了外觀一致，把接觸面一併噴上面漆，或運輸時接觸面沾到油污，Class B 設計的接頭實際只有更低的摩擦，在設計風力或地震下滑動，支撐系統變形增大並使相鄰構件承受額外力量。~A painter coating faying areas for a uniform look, or oil picked up in transport, leaves a joint designed for Class B with much lower friction, so it slips under design wind or seismic load, bracing deformations grow and adjacent members pick up extra force.
units.misconception: 接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。~An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint.
units.practice: 接觸面在製造廠就以遮蔽膠帶標示並在施工圖註明「接觸面勿塗」，現場組立前由檢驗員簽認接觸面狀態；運輸與吊裝時以覆蓋保護接觸面，受污染者須重新清理至規定等級。~Mask faying areas at the shop and mark the shop drawings with a do-not-paint note, and have the inspector sign off faying-surface condition before field fit-up; protect faying areas with covers during shipping and erection, and re-clean any contaminated area to the specified class.

units.anchor: 密貼狀態與鎖緊順序~Snug-tight state and tightening sequence
units.title: 密貼與系統化鎖緊順序~Snugging and systematic tightening sequence
units.mechanism: 預拉之前，接頭必須先達到密貼：所有板件緊密接觸，通常由鐵工以一般扳手全力鎖緊或衝擊扳手數次衝擊達成。鎖緊要從接頭最剛硬的部分（通常是中央）往自由邊系統化推進，因為後鎖的螺栓會把板件進一步拉近，使先鎖的螺栓夾緊力下降。板件較厚、層數較多或板面不平時，往往需要多輪鎖緊，才能讓每一支螺栓在最後都達到最低預拉力。~Before pretensioning, a joint must be snug: all plies in firm contact, usually achieved by an ironworker's full effort on an ordinary spanner or a few impacts of an impact wrench. Tightening must progress systematically from the most rigid part of the joint, usually the centre, toward the free edges, because later bolts pull the plies closer and reduce the clamp on bolts tightened earlier. Thick plates, many plies or uneven surfaces often require several passes before every bolt finally reaches minimum pretension.
units.model: 若每鎖緊一支相鄰螺栓會使先鎖螺栓損失約 5% 夾緊力，第一輪鎖到 173 kN 的螺栓在其後三支相鄰螺栓鎖緊後剩 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN，只有 86%，低於最低預拉力，須再鎖第二輪。數值為教學假設。~If tightening each neighbouring bolt costs an earlier bolt about 5% of its clamp, a bolt brought to 173 kN in the first pass keeps only 173×0.95³ ≈ 148 kN after three neighbours are tightened, 86% and below minimum pretension, so a second pass is needed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 密貼後檢查板件間是否仍有可見縫隙，大型接頭可用塞尺抽查；鎖緊順序寫入安裝程序並由檢驗員抽查觀察，若發現由邊緣往中央鎖或一次鎖完單支，要求重新密貼並依序重做。~After snugging, check for visible gaps between plies, using a feeler gauge on large joints; write the tightening sequence into the installation procedure and have inspectors observe it, requiring re-snugging and a proper sequence if bolts are tightened from the edges inward or one at a time to full tension.
units.failure: 厚板接頭未先全面密貼就直接逐支鎖到最終預拉，先鎖的螺栓在後續鎖緊中被放鬆，接頭中央夾緊力不足；若是轉角法，鬆動後的螺栓已經轉過規定角度，標記看似合格，實際預拉力卻不足。~Taking bolts in a thick-plate joint one by one to final pretension without first snugging the whole joint loosens the early bolts as later ones are tightened, leaving the joint centre under-clamped; with turn-of-nut, those relaxed bolts have already turned the required angle, so their marks look right while their pretension is short.
units.misconception: 每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。~Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.
units.practice: 安裝程序應規定密貼與預拉為兩個分開的階段，並把接頭密貼後的檢查列為停留點；厚板或多層板接頭的鎖緊輪數與順序應在首件安裝時以張力量測確認，再推廣到其餘接頭。~The installation procedure should treat snugging and pretensioning as separate stages with a hold point after snugging; for thick or multi-ply joints, confirm the number of passes and sequence on the first joint by tension measurement before applying it to the rest.

units.anchor: 螺帽轉角標記與張力指示墊圈~Turn-of-nut marks and DTI washers
units.title: 轉角法、扭剪型螺栓與張力指示墊圈~Turn-of-nut, twist-off bolts and DTIs
units.mechanism: 預拉方法的核心是用可檢查的量取代不可靠的扭力：轉角法在密貼後把螺帽相對螺栓轉過規定角度，以應變控制使螺栓進入非彈性範圍，預拉力穩定；扭剪型螺栓在尾端花鍵被扳手扭斷時達到張力；直接張力指示墊圈的凸點被壓扁到規定間隙，以塞尺判定；另有合併法。RCSC 2025 年版規範撤除了校正扳手法，因為扭力與張力的關係受潤滑、螺紋狀態與溫度影響很大。轉角量依螺栓長度與直徑比而定，例如長度不超過 4 倍直徑時為 1/3 圈。~Pretensioning methods replace unreliable torque with checkable quantities: turn-of-nut rotates the nut a specified angle relative to the bolt after snugging, using strain control to push the bolt into the inelastic range for consistent pretension; twist-off tension-control bolts reach tension when the spline end shears off; direct tension indicators have protrusions that flatten to a specified gap judged with a feeler gauge; and a combined method also exists. The 2025 RCSC Specification withdrew the calibrated wrench method, because the torque–tension relation varies greatly with lubrication, thread condition and temperature. Turn-of-nut rotation depends on bolt length relative to diameter, for example 1/3 turn when the length is no more than four diameters.
units.model: 7/8 in 螺栓每英吋 9 牙，螺距 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm，1/3 圈螺帽前進約 0.94 mm。達到 173 kN 時螺栓應力 173,000/298 ≈ 581 MPa、應變約 0.0029，70 mm 有效長度只需伸長約 0.20 mm；轉角提供的位移約為 4.6 倍，因此螺栓進入非彈性範圍，預拉力穩定超過最低值。數值為教學假設。~A 7/8 in bolt has 9 threads per inch, a pitch of 25.4/9 ≈ 2.82 mm, so 1/3 turn advances the nut about 0.94 mm. At 173 kN the bolt stress is 173,000/298 ≈ 581 MPa, a strain of about 0.0029, needing only about 0.20 mm of stretch over a 70 mm effective length; the rotation supplies about 4.6 times that, so the bolt goes inelastic and pretension reliably exceeds the minimum. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 轉角法在密貼後於螺帽、螺栓端與鋼板上畫連續標記，完成後檢查標記錯開的角度；扭剪型螺栓檢查尾端是否扭斷，但須先確認螺栓在扭斷前已密貼；張力指示墊圈以塞尺檢查間隙拒入的數量，並注意墊圈方向與位置是否依規定。~For turn-of-nut, draw continuous match marks on nut, bolt end and steel after snugging and check their offset angle afterwards; for twist-off bolts, check that the spline has sheared, having confirmed the joint was snug before shearing; for direct tension indicators, count feeler-gauge refusals and confirm washer orientation and position as specified.
units.failure: 扭剪型螺栓若在接頭尚未密貼時就一次扭斷尾端，扭力大多消耗在拉近板件，螺栓張力不足卻有合格外觀；張力指示墊圈裝反方向或放在轉動側，凸點被磨平而非壓扁，判讀失真。~If twist-off bolts are sheared in one go before the joint is snug, much of the torque goes into drawing the plies together, leaving low tension behind a passing appearance; a direct tension indicator fitted the wrong way round or under the turned element has its protrusions ground rather than compressed, falsifying the reading.
units.misconception: 只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。~Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely.
units.practice: 每一種預拉方法都要寫成書面安裝程序，包含密貼、標記、鎖緊順序與判定方式，並在開工前以安裝前驗證確認；預拉作業屬鐵工專業工作，人員須受訓並由檢驗員核准，本課只說明檢核邏輯，不構成作業許可。~Write every pretensioning method as a procedure covering snugging, marking, sequence and acceptance, proven by pre-installation verification before work; pretensioning is skilled ironwork requiring trained crews approved by the inspector, and this course explains the checking logic only, not a work permit.

units.anchor: 螺栓張力校正器~Bolt tension calibrator
units.title: 安裝前驗證試驗~Pre-installation verification testing
units.mechanism: 任何預拉方法在現場使用前，都要以同批的螺栓、螺帽與墊圈組件，在液壓式螺栓張力校正器中照實際程序鎖緊，量測得到的張力，確認方法、工具與組件組合能達到規定的最低預拉力並留有餘裕（一般要求至少 1.05 倍）。這項試驗能抓出潤滑不足、批次不符、工具設定錯誤或螺栓太短無法裝入校正器等問題；RCSC 2025 年版另新增了驗證不合格時的處理程序。驗證要在每一批、每一種直徑與長度組合開工時進行。~Before any pretensioning method is used in the field, assemblies of bolts, nuts and washers from the same lots are tightened by the actual procedure in a hydraulic bolt tension calibrator and the tension measured, confirming that method, tools and assemblies reach the specified minimum pretension with margin, typically at least 1.05 times. The test catches poor lubrication, mismatched lots, wrong tool settings, or bolts too short to fit the calibrator; the 2025 RCSC edition also adds procedures for nonconforming verification tests. Verification is done at the start of work for every lot and every diameter and length combination.
units.model: 7/8 in A325 最低預拉 173 kN，驗證要求 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN。三組試驗得 186、190、179 kN：平均 185 kN，但 179 kN < 181.7 kN，此組合判不合格，須查明潤滑或程序後重做，不能以平均值放行。數值為教學假設。~For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN. Three assemblies give 186, 190 and 179 kN: the average is 185 kN, but 179 kN < 181.7 kN, so the combination fails and lubrication or procedure must be investigated and the test repeated; the average cannot release it. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。~The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension; for turn-of-nut also record the rotation needed to reach minimum tension, and for twist-off bolts and indicators record the actual tension at shear-off or gap acceptance.
units.failure: 若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。~Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy.
units.misconception: 出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。~Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.
units.practice: 把安裝前驗證列為每一批螺栓開工前的停留點，未完成驗證的批次不得發放到工作面；太短而無法放入校正器的螺栓，應依規範採用替代的直接張力量測方法，不能直接免驗。~Make pre-installation verification a hold point before each lot is used, with unverified lots not issued to the work face; bolts too short for the calibrator must be verified by an alternative direct-tension method allowed by the specification, never simply exempted.

units.anchor: 稽查扭力與標記檢查~Arbitration torque and mark checks
units.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核~Post-installation inspection and arbitration
units.mechanism: 預拉螺栓完成後無法直接看出張力，因此檢驗重點在於觀察過程：檢驗員觀察安裝前驗證，並定期觀察鐵工是否依程序密貼、標記與鎖緊，最後檢查轉角標記、扭斷尾端或指示墊圈間隙。若對已安裝螺栓有疑問，可用稽查扭力法：先以同批組件在校正器中求出達到規定張力所需的扭力，再以校正過的扭力扳手檢查現場螺栓是否在該扭力下不再轉動；RCSC 2025 年版新增稽查用扭力扳手的校正要求。~Because pretension cannot be seen once a bolt is installed, inspection focuses on observing the process: the inspector witnesses pre-installation verification, periodically watches crews snug, mark and tighten by procedure, and finally checks match marks, sheared splines or indicator gaps. Where installed bolts are in dispute, arbitration torque is used: the torque needed to reach specified tension is found for same-lot assemblies in the calibrator, then a calibrated torque wrench checks whether field bolts resist turning at that torque; the 2025 RCSC edition adds calibration requirements for the arbitration torque wrench.
units.model: 扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。以同批組件校正得 K = 0.20、D = 22.2 mm、目標 F = 182 kN：稽查扭力 T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m。若潤滑改變使 K 落在 0.12 至 0.30，同樣扭力對應的張力差約 2.5 倍，這說明扭力只適合作為同批比較，而不能用來安裝。數值為教學假設。~Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F. Calibrating same-lot assemblies gives K = 0.20, with D = 22.2 mm and target F = 182 kN, so the arbitration torque is T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m. If lubrication shifts K anywhere from 0.12 to 0.30, the same torque implies tensions differing by a factor of 2.5, which is why torque suits same-lot comparison only, not installation. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。~For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check.
units.failure: 若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。~If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk.
units.misconception: 完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。~A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately.
units.practice: 檢驗計畫要把觀察安裝前驗證與施工中鎖緊列為主要檢驗手段，完工後的稽查扭力只用於爭議處理；稽查扭力扳手須有校正紀錄，判定規則與擴大抽查方式須事先在合約中約定。~The inspection plan should make witnessing verification and in-process tightening the primary means, reserving post-installation arbitration torque for disputes; the arbitration wrench must have calibration records, and acceptance and escalation rules must be agreed in the contract beforehand.

units.anchor: 預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕~Pretension relaxation and corrosion
units.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊~Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening
units.mechanism: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。由於螺栓的軸向勁度很高，被夾區域只要縮短百分之幾毫米，夾緊力就明顯下降。高強度螺栓還可能因環境氫或腐蝕反應而延遲斷裂。維護時常見的問題是是否可以重新鎖緊：A490 與鍍鋅的 A325 螺栓不得重複使用，鬆動的螺栓通常應更換而非直接回鎖。~Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration. Because a bolt is axially very stiff, the clamped zone need only shorten by hundredths of a millimetre for clamp force to drop noticeably. High-strength bolts may also suffer delayed fracture from environmental hydrogen or corrosion reactions. A common maintenance question is whether bolts may be retightened: A490 and galvanized A325 bolts must not be reused, and loose bolts are usually replaced rather than simply retightened.
units.model: 螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。若接觸面塗層潛變使夾緊長度縮短 0.02 mm，預拉力損失 ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN，約為 173 kN 的 10%。數值為教學假設。~Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm. If faying-coating creep shortens the clamped length by 0.02 mm, pretension falls by ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN, about 10% of 173 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。~At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test.
units.failure: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。~Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it.
units.misconception: 鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。~A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.
units.practice: 維護手冊應規定鬆動、缺失或腐蝕螺栓的處理：同時更換螺栓、螺帽與墊圈，依原規格重新驗證與預拉，並確認接觸面狀態；一次更換一支，避免整個接頭同時失去夾緊，必要時由結構工程師指定更換順序。~The maintenance manual should set rules for loose, missing or corroded bolts: replace bolt, nut and washer together, re-verify and pretension to the original specification and check the faying surface; replace one bolt at a time so the joint never loses all its clamp, with the structural engineer setting the sequence where needed.

units.anchor: 批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖~Lots, verification records and bolt map
units.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接~Bolting records, traceability and handover
units.mechanism: 鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm；高強度螺栓接頭則可以檢查、更換與重新預拉，但前提是紀錄完整。交接文件要讓維護人員知道：哪些接頭是摩擦型或預拉型、使用哪個等級與批號、採用何種預拉方法、安裝前驗證與稽核結果、曾經有哪些不符合項目與更換。沒有這些紀錄，任何一支斷裂螺栓都無法判斷是單一事件還是整批問題。~Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long; high-strength bolted joints can be inspected, replaced and re-pretensioned, but only if the records are complete. Handover documents must tell maintainers which joints are slip-critical or pretensioned, which grade and lot was used, which pretensioning method, the verification and audit results, and any nonconformances and replacements. Without these records, nobody can tell whether a broken bolt is an isolated event or a lot-wide problem.
units.model: 若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。這說明稽核抽樣應以接頭為單位，並以批號紀錄追查集中問題。數值為教學假設。~If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt. Audit samples should therefore be drawn by joint, with lot records used to trace clustered problems. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。~Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location.
units.failure: 若交接時只留下「螺栓已依規範施工」的結論，多年後在某接頭發現延遲斷裂的螺栓，業主無法知道同批螺栓還用在哪裡，只能全面檢查或大量更換，成本與停用時間都大幅增加。~If handover leaves only a statement that bolting met the specification, an owner who finds a delayed-fracture bolt years later cannot know where else that lot was used and must inspect or replace across the structure, at much greater cost and downtime.
units.misconception: 螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。~Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
units.practice: 合約應要求以數位格式交付螺栓批號與使用位置對照、安裝前驗證與稽核紀錄、不符合項目處理與螺栓配置圖；業主的維護手冊要列出關鍵受拉與摩擦型接頭的檢查週期，並指定由誰判定是否需要更換。~The contract should require digital delivery of lot-to-location records, verification and audit records, nonconformance dispositions and the bolt layout drawing; the owner's maintenance manual should list inspection intervals for critical tension and slip-critical joints and name who decides on replacement.

example: 設計練習：某鋼構支撐續接需傳遞使用剪力 900 kN，採 7/8 in A325 螺栓、雙剪面、標準孔。(1) 最低預拉 T_b = 0.70×120 ksi×0.462 in² ≈ 39 kips ≈ 173 kN。(2) 接觸面採噴砂 Class B（μ = 0.50）：每支 2×0.50×1.13×173 ≈ 195 kN，需 900/195 ≈ 4.6 支，為對稱配置取 6 支。(3) 螺栓長 4.5 in（約 114 mm），L/d ≈ 5.1，依轉角表介於 4d 與 8d 之間，密貼後轉 1/2 圈。(4) 安裝前驗證要求每組 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN，三組 186、190、185 kN 均合格後才能開工。(5) 若改變一個輸入：接觸面誤塗面漆而只能以 Class A（μ = 0.30）計，每支只剩約 117 kN，需 900/117 ≈ 7.7 支，原本 6 支的接頭抗滑力約只有需求的 78%，須清除塗層或增加螺栓。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際結構。~Design exercise: a steel brace splice must carry 900 kN of service shear using 7/8 in A325 bolts in double shear with standard holes. (1) Minimum pretension T_b = 0.70×120 ksi×0.462 in² ≈ 39 kips ≈ 173 kN. (2) With blast-cleaned Class B faying surfaces (μ = 0.50), each bolt gives 2×0.50×1.13×173 ≈ 195 kN, needing 900/195 ≈ 4.6 bolts, so 6 are used for a symmetric layout. (3) The bolt length is 4.5 in (about 114 mm), L/d ≈ 5.1, between 4d and 8d in the turn-of-nut table, so the nut is turned 1/2 turn after snugging. (4) Pre-installation verification requires each assembly to reach at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN; three assemblies at 186, 190 and 185 kN pass before work starts. (5) Changing one input: if the faying surfaces were painted by mistake and only Class A (μ = 0.30) can be counted, each bolt gives about 117 kN, needing 900/117 ≈ 7.7 bolts, so the six-bolt joint has only about 78% of the required slip resistance and the coating must be removed or bolts added. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real structure.
history: 二十世紀上半葉的大型鋼構以熱鉚接為主，1932 年通車的雪梨港灣大橋即由約六百萬支手工鉚釘組成。RCSC 於 1951 年 1 月發布第一版高強度螺栓接頭規範，使預拉螺栓逐步取代鉚釘，此後已出版 18 個版本；2025 年版撤除校正扳手法，並新增螺栓施工人員資格與承包商責任等條文。1979 年 Kemper Arena 屋頂吊架螺栓失效，以及 2013 年海灣大橋東段高強度錨桿在受拉後兩週內大量斷裂，都提醒工程師預拉、材料與氫脆控制必須一併管理。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Large steel structures of the early twentieth century were mostly hot-riveted; Sydney Harbour Bridge, opened in 1932, is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets. RCSC published its first specification for high-strength bolted joints in January 1951, letting pretensioned bolts gradually replace rivets, and has issued 18 successive editions since; the 2025 edition withdrew the calibrated wrench method and added provisions on bolting personnel qualifications and contractor responsibilities. The 1979 failure of Kemper Arena's roof hanger bolts and the 2013 fracture of many high-strength anchor rods on the Bay Bridge East Span within two weeks of tensioning both remind engineers that pretension, material and hydrogen-embrittlement control must be managed together. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

7/8 in 螺栓最低預拉力為最低抗拉強度的 70%：A325 約 39 kips（173 kN）、A490 約 49 kips（218 kN）~Minimum pretension for 7/8 in bolts is 70% of minimum tensile strength: about 39 kips (173 kN) for A325 and 49 kips (218 kN) for A490

雪梨港灣大橋約有 600 萬支手工鉚釘，最大一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm~Sydney Harbour Bridge has about 6 million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long
